groups.label: Join the kernel's axes
groups.meaning: Commute with every generator of the group and lie on an axis the kernel carries: the flag face, the left arrangement or the tick.

operations.name: Diffuse
operations.note: probed as Diffuse

operations.note: probed as Apply(PleromaKernel)

operations.note: probed as PleromaKernel.Add(flagMask,arr,time,w)

operations.name: PleromaKernel.Add(PleromaKernel)
operations.note: probed as PleromaKernel.Add(PleromaKernel)

operations.name: PleromaKernel.Compose
operations.note: probed as PleromaKernel.Compose

operations.name: PleromaKernel.Adjoint
operations.note: probed as PleromaKernel.Adjoint

operations.note: probed as Flags()

operations.name: Add(Pleroma)
operations.note: affine in the state, equivariant in the pair

operations.name: Subtract(Pleroma)
operations.note: affine in the state, equivariant in the pair

operations.name: Total
operations.note: probed as Total()

operations.name: Flags(bits)
operations.note: probed as Flags(bits {0,2})

operations.name: Pleroma.FlagsMany(stores, bits)
operations.note: by reduction: equal per store to Flags(bits), cell for cell

operations.name: Pleroma.FlagsUnion(stores, bitSets)
operations.note: by reduction: equal per store to Flags(bits), cell for cell

operations.name: PleromaReadSet.Read(stores)
operations.note: by reduction: equal per read to Flags(bits), cell for cell

operations.name: PleromaReadSet.Run(kernel, stores)
operations.note: by reduction: the kernel applies, then the reads

operations.name: PleromaKernel.AddKeyed(keyShift, flagMask, arrangement, timeShift, weight)
operations.note: keyed kernel (key-harmonic axis): joins every generator

groups.label: Commute, off the axes
groups.meaning: Commute with every generator but do not lie on an axis the kernel carries, such as the key shift of an unkeyed kernel.

operations.name: ShiftKeys
operations.note: commutes with G; a kernel element only through a keyed kernel: the method itself stays one pass per call

operations.name: Syndrome
operations.note: index declared: a flag XOR by a shifts the syndrome by s(a); key, arrangement and time invariant

operations.name: TimeSpectrum
operations.note: declared: the key x tick histogram, flattened key-major; key2 moves the key index, time1 rotates the tick

operations.name: Arrangements
operations.note: probed as Arrangements()

operations.name: Times
operations.note: probed as Times()

operations.name: JointCounts
operations.note: index declared: flag XOR on w, arrangement composition on g, +1 on t

operations.name: Counts
operations.note: index declared: key shift permutes the key index

operations.name: InnerProduct
operations.note: invariant in the pair

operations.name: Project
operations.note: output on fewer faces: a generator of a dropped face leaves the output unchanged (f(Gen s) = f(s))

operations.name: CountsInto
operations.note: as Counts

operations.name: Hadamard
operations.note: pair-equivariant; dense key convolution: NOT kernel-representable

operations.name: FlagInnerProduct
operations.note: invariant in the pair

groups.label: Linear, break a symmetry
groups.meaning: Linear or affine, and break at least one named generator: a bit permutation of the flags, a key scaling, a Frobenius squaring, a bind.

operations.name: RelabelFlags
operations.note: bit map breaks flag1, flag2; the XOR form joins

operations.name: RelabelArrangements
operations.note: right action breaks; the left form joins

operations.name: ScaleKeys
operations.note: breaks key2 (key permutation)

operations.name: Frobenius
operations.note: breaks flag2, flag4 (fixes flag mask 1 only)

operations.name: ShiftRegister
operations.note: breaks flag1, flag2, flag4

operations.name: Apply(FlagOperator)
operations.note: bit map breaks flag1, flag2; signs are not kernel elements

operations.name: MapTimes
operations.note: breaks time1

operations.name: ModulateKeys
operations.note: breaks key2 by a phase (Weyl partner of ShiftKeys)

operations.name: MultiplyKeys
operations.note: breaks key2 (fixed weights)

operations.name: MultiplyTimes
operations.note: breaks time1 (fixed weights)

operations.name: ApplyBank
operations.note: key-axis store map: non-constant diagonals break key2; flags, arrangements and time commute

operations.name: FlagOperator.Apply(counts)
operations.note: a bit permutation of the flag index: breaks flag1, flag2

operations.name: Bind
operations.note: bilinear: breaks the right arrangement translations only

operations.name: Restrict
operations.note: a predicate on flag words: breaks flag1; probed on a flags-and-keys shape (order and time faces are refused by FlagSpectrum, see the probe note)

operations.name: Near
operations.note: fixed query: breaks flag1, flag2, flag4

operations.name: SignBalance
operations.note: the arrangement sign character: breaks the right and left arrangement translations

operations.name: CountWhere
operations.note: fixed predicate: breaks flag1

operations.name: CountWhereByTime
operations.note: fixed predicate: breaks flag1

operations.name: CountWhereByArrangement
operations.note: fixed predicate: breaks flag2

operations.name: BitCounts
operations.note: affine output: complement under a flag XOR

operations.name: MergeProjection
operations.note: affine in the store; the projection lands at arrangement 0 and time 0: breaks arrR1, arrR2, time1

operations.name: CountWhereKey
operations.note: fixed key predicate: breaks key2

operations.name: FromCounts
operations.note: counts land at flag word 0, arrangement 0, time 0: breaks the flag, arrangement and time translations; key2 commutes

operations.name: AddCounts
operations.note: a write at flag word 0, arrangement 0, time 0: breaks the translations of those faces

operations.name: AddFlagCounts
operations.note: a write at key 0: breaks key2, time1, the right arrangements

operations.name: TimeWeightedCounts
operations.note: fixed weights: breaks time1

operations.name: AddFlagWords (instance)
operations.note: a write at key 0, arrangement 0, time 0

operations.name: AddFlagWords (stores)
operations.note: by reduction: equal per store to the instance form (PleromaFlagWordsTests)

groups.label: Not linear
groups.meaning: Choices, decodes, order statistics, draws and predicates.

operations.name: Eliminate
operations.note: returns a solved rule (FlagRule?): a choice, not a state map; not probed

operations.name: IsIndependent
operations.note: a Boolean predicate of the store; not probed

operations.name: Sample
operations.note: a seeded draw with probability count/total: a choice; not probed

operations.name: SampleKey
operations.note: a seeded key draw: a choice; not probed

operations.name: TimeMap
operations.note: selects one tick per key, or -1 for a mix: a selection, not additive (the record count is probed)

operations.name: TryFindConflicts
operations.note: decode with refusal; not probed

operations.name: TryKeys
operations.note: decode with refusal (count component probed)

operations.name: TryItems
operations.note: decode with refusal; not probed

operations.name: Nearest
operations.note: the distance component is probed; the word list is a selection

operations.name: FlagParity
operations.note: XOR of words: lid

operations.name: MinKey
operations.note: order statistic: lid

operations.name: MaxKey
operations.note: order statistic: lid

operations.name: KeyAtRank
operations.note: order statistic: lid

operations.name: Verify
operations.note: Boolean check of the redundancy cells (ReservedKeys): a predicate; not probed (a constant true would classify as affine)

operations.name: VerifyCheck
operations.note: Boolean check of the check prime: a predicate; not probed (as Verify)

operations.name: MapCounts
operations.note: lid

operations.name: Support
operations.note: lid

groups.label: Need a declaration
groups.meaning: Need an output-action declaration before a probe can classify them. The record gives the reason for each.

operations.name: PleromaKernel.Graded
operations.note: builds a graded kernel algebra: no store input to probe

operations.name: CombineCycles
operations.note: two-state map across two complete cycles (G10): not a one-store probe in this harness (named)

operations.name: Attend
operations.note: a fixed query; the PleromaAttention record has no declared induced action; not probed

operations.name: Density
operations.note: continuous component (floats): approximate, no exact commutation test

operations.name: Similarity
operations.note: continuous component (floats): approximate

operations.name: FadedTimes
operations.note: continuous component (floats): approximate

operations.name: RelationPairs
operations.note: relation face: outside the flag and key lattice (G13)

operations.name: ReadLoop
operations.note: relation face (G13)

operations.name: Holonomy
operations.note: relation face (G13)

operations.name: Frustration
operations.note: relation face (G13)

operations.name: Current
operations.note: relation face (G13)

operations.name: ProjectFlags
operations.note: as Project on the kept flag bits: the generator masks restrict to the kept bits, which the harness does not do (named)

operations.name: Repair
operations.note: reserved-key cells sit outside the probe shapes (ReservedKeys)

operations.name: CausalReads
operations.note: stream input (prefix-indexed outputs): not a state map

operations.name: ToComplex
operations.note: continuous output (floats)
